templates.title: Name Change Affidavit
templates.body: I solemnly affirm that my previous and current names belong to one and the same person.

templates.title: Address Confirmation Affidavit
templates.body: I hereby declare that I reside at the address stated above and the information provided is true.

templates.title: Single Status Affidavit
templates.body: I affirm that I am unmarried and legally free to marry.

templates.title: Identity Affidavit
templates.body: I solemnly declare that the information furnished by me is true and correct.
